stories.title: ‘No one is prepared’: ChatGPT maker’s top scientist sends an AI warning
stories.simple_summary: A top scientist at the company that made ChatGPT is warning that AI is developing very fast and most people and organizations aren't ready for what comes next.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a warning for business leaders and governments to think ahead — ordinary people should stay curious about AI but don't need to panic or rush.

stories.title: With AI Remarks, Deming Dismisses Integrity at Harvard
stories.simple_summary: Harvard's president made some comments about AI that critics say showed poor judgment or dishonesty.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about Harvard's internal leadership — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra model autonomously completes Portal in 24 hours — feat cost just $571 in tokens
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's new AI model solved a complex puzzle on its own in one day, spending only about $571 in computer costs to do it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors and engineers — it shows AI is getting faster and cheaper, but this particular achievement doesn't yet change what tools you can use in your business.

stories.title: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
stories.simple_summary: The chief scientist at OpenAI is publicly warning that nobody is truly prepared for how powerful and widespread AI will become.
stories.why_it_matters: This is similar to headline 0 — it's a heads-up to stay aware, but not something ordinary people need to act on right now.

stories.title: It took 74 years, but this lifelong Luddite learned to stop worrying and love AI
stories.simple_summary: Someone who avoided technology most of their life has decided to embrace and learn about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a personal story showing it's never too late to get comfortable with new technology — encouraging but not urgent.

stories.title: Exclusive: Ineffable Intelligence adds 6 "cofounders," hiring from Google DeepMind and InstaDeep
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company called Ineffable Intelligence hired six top scientists who used to work at Google's AI team and other AI labs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors following the AI industry — it's not relevant to your small business or daily life.

stories.title: Breakingviews - COMMENTARY: How to make the world safer for AI
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece discusses how to make sure AI is developed safely.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a high-level policy discussion — not something you need to worry about or act on now.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
stories.simple_summary: Two newspapers (Seattle Times and Newsday) are suing OpenAI and Microsoft, claiming the companies used their news articles to teach AI without asking permission and the AI now copies passages from their stories.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a small business with valuable content, this shows you might want to think about who has permission to use your work — but for most people, this is mainly a legal battle between big companies.

stories.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
stories.simple_summary: Authors are disagreeing with publishers and agents over who should receive money from a settlement deal with AI companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to professional writers and publishers — the outcome may affect how AI companies handle authors' work in the future.

stories.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
stories.simple_summary: Travis Kalanick (the founder of Uber) is reportedly considering having his company Atoms get involved in self-driving robot taxis.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people interested in taxi and transportation — if you run a regular business, this doesn't directly affect you yet.

stories.title: I’m a father of three who studies the impact of artificial intelligence: this is what parents need to know about AI
stories.simple_summary: A researcher who studies AI is writing advice for parents about how to help their kids understand and safely use AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren or children, this is worth paying attention to — it's practical guidance on keeping young people safe with new technology.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
stories.simple_summary: Two more newspapers are joining lawsuits against OpenAI and Microsoft over using their journalism to train AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: Similar to headline 7 — this is a legal issue between publishers and tech companies; most small business owners don't need to act now, but it shows an ongoing battle over who controls content.
